discovery_confirm.title: Xiaomi Camera
discovery_confirm.description:
The {name} add-on was found. Set it up now?

You will sign in to your Xiaomi account on the add-on's own page afterwards.

install_addon.title: Install the bridge
install_addon.description:
Your cameras are streamed by the {addon} add-on, which runs alongside Home Assistant. It will be installed and started for you.

This takes a few minutes.

addon_unavailable.title: Add-on repository missing
addon_unavailable.description:
The {addon} add-on is not available in your add-on store yet. Add this project's repository under Settings → Add-ons → Add-on Store → Repositories, install the add-on, then come back.

Continue to enter a bridge address manually instead.

manual.title: Connect to the bridge
manual.description: Enter the address of the Xiaomi Camera Bridge. Use 127.0.0.1 when it runs on this machine.

cameras.title: Choose cameras
cameras.description: Which of your Xiaomi cameras should appear in Home Assistant? You can change this later.

data_description.cameras: Only the cameras you tick get entities. The rest stay in the Mi Home app and are not published.
data_description.auto_add: A camera added to your account later joins on its own. Turn this off to decide each one yourself.
data_description.stream_codec: H.264 is transcoded by the add-on and plays in every browser and in Apple Home. H.265 is the camera's native encoding: better quality and no transcoding cost, but it requires a device capable of decoding it, such as Safari or a browser with hardware support.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge at that address.
error.not_linked: The add-on still has no Xiaomi account linked. Sign in on its page first.

abort.already_configured: The bridge is already set up.
abort.addon_start_failed: The add-on could not be started: {error}
abort.addon_install_failed: The add-on could not be installed: {error}

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge add-on.
abort.no_cameras: No supported cameras were found on this account.

not_linked.title: Xiaomi account is not signed in
not_linked.description: The {addon} add-on has no Xiaomi account signed in, so no cameras can be read. Open the add-on's page and sign in there — the account belongs to the add-on and is never held by Home Assistant. This message clears itself once it does.
